# What does this PR do ?

Fixes offline (`HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`) exports dropping the files `_copy_custom_modeling_files` copies from a Hub source, which makes the nemotron-3-nano-4b GPU export fail with `GenerationConfig is invalid ... top_p`.

# Changelog

- `src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py`: when `list_repo_files()` fails (for example with `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`), `_copy_custom_modeling_files` copies the matching files from the cached snapshot of the requested revision instead, per pattern via `snapshot_download(..., local_files_only=True, allow_patterns=[pattern])`, by repository-relative path, and logs the fallback. Behavior is unchanged when the listing succeeds; a revision that is not cached still copies nothing.
- `tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py`: offline fallback for a commit revision and the default branch, an incomplete cached snapshot handled per pattern, `save_artifacts` keeping the source `generation_config.json` offline, and still raising when the revision is not cached.

# GitHub Actions CI

See the [CI section](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md#-running-github-ci) in the Contributing doc for how to trigger the CI. A Nvidia developer will need to approve and trigger the CI for external contributors.

# Before your PR is "Ready for review"

**Pre checks**:

- [x] Make sure you read and followed [Contributor guidelines](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md)
- [x] Did you write any new necessary tests?
- [ ] Did you add or update any necessary documentation?
- [ ] Does the PR affect components that are optional to install? (Ex: Numba, Pynini, Apex etc)
  - [ ] Reviewer: Does the PR have correct import guards for all optional libraries?

# Additional Information

- **Root cause:** #4994 made `save_artifacts` keep the source `generation_config.json` verbatim when Transformers refuses to re-save it under strict validation. For a Hub model ID that copy goes through `_copy_custom_modeling_files`, which starts with `list_repo_files()`. Offline, that call raises `OfflineModeIsEnabled`, the helper silently copies nothing, and the original `ValueError` is re-raised. nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-3-Nano-4B-BF16 sets `top_p` without `do_sample`. The same gap silently drops bridge-specific additional files such as `nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py` from offline exports.
- **Other affected models:** zai-org/GLM-5, zai-org/GLM-5.2 and LGAI-EXAONE/K-EXAONE-2.0-750B-A37B ship the same generation config pattern (`top_p` without `do_sample`; checked by re-saving each card's pinned `generation_config.json` with Transformers 5.17.0), and their verification-card exports pass a Hub ID as `--hf-model`, so they fail offline the same way without this change.
- **Relation to [#6625](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/pull/6625):** #6625 fixes `convert.sh`/`infer.sh --executor slurm` resolving relative `work/` paths in the NeMo-Run job directory. With it, the nemotron-3-nano-4b card's export gets past the path error and then hits this failure in offline runs, so the card commands need both.
- **Verification** (26.10 release-candidate container, 1x H100, the nemotron-3-nano-4b card's `convert.sh`/`infer.sh --executor slurm` commands, `HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1`):
  - r0.7.0: export fails with `FileNotFoundError` (the path bug).
  - r0.7.0 + #6625: export fails with `ValueError: GenerationConfig is invalid ... top_p`; the same export passes online.
  - r0.7.0 + #6625 + this PR: export passes; all 263 tensors are bitwise equal to the pinned source, `generation_config.json` is byte-identical, and the output matches the online export of #6625 alone. `infer.sh --task hf-inference` reloads it strictly and continues "The capital of France is" with " Paris.".
  - Unit tests: the new tests fail on main and pass here; the `hf_pretrained`, nemotron_omni conversion, flux and wan tests that use this helper pass (148).
- **Release:** needs the r0.7.0 cherry-pick together with #6625.
- NVBug 6978311

<!-- nemo-ci-review-impact:v1 ceiling=moderate -->

One blocking correctness issue: the offline fallback does not honor an explicitly configured Hub cache, so it can miss the source artifact or copy a different cached default revision.

Reviewed both changed files and the affected artifact-loading/export paths. Validation was static only; tests were not executed.

No perf tests impacted.

### Suggested test cases
- `test_save_artifacts_uses_explicit_hub_cache_when_offline` — proposed regression covering pinned and default revisions with different default-cache contents.
- [`test_copy_custom_modeling_files_uses_hub_cache_when_hub_is_offline`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L356-L387) — both revision values.
- [`test_copy_custom_modeling_files_uses_incomplete_hub_cache_per_pattern`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L390-L414).
- [`test_save_artifacts_preserves_generation_config_from_hub_cache_when_offline`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L417-L440).
- [`test_save_artifacts_reraises_generation_config_error_when_hub_revision_is_not_cached`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L443-L458).

> **Note:** formal approval is not available for this request, so this review is posted as a comment only.

*Review generated by codex. This was a full review. Request a full review with `/review reset=true`.*

<!-- nemo-ci-review-rendering:inline-v1 -->
<!-- nemo-ci-formal-review:14d4a7cfa552830749e45159c619da987506c838ac2a5e31b0c42fdb45d323c4:a58e3731f77121aef12034b05cf8c7dd2eb7a5b491a558639fca8421531eb074 -->

[P2] Honor the source loader's explicit cache directory

**Failure — source reasoning, not executed:** `PreTrainedCausalLM.from_pretrained("org/model", cache_dir=custom_cache)` loads generation metadata from that cache because the [loader forwards `self.init_kwargs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/causal_lm.py#L249-L257). This snapshot lookup instead always uses the default cache. Offline, if `custom_cache` contains the loaded main revision with `{"top_p": 0.95}` while the default cache contains an older main with `{"top_p": 0.8}`, a rejected generation-config save copies the older file and incorrectly succeeds. With an explicit commit cached only in `custom_cache`, the helper returns no files and [the save re-raises](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L298-L305) despite the source file being available. Expected behavior is to preserve the artifact from the cache used to load the source.

**Correction:** thread `self.init_kwargs.get("cache_dir")` through `_copy_custom_modeling_files` into `_copy_cached_hub_files` and `snapshot_download`. The invariant is that the fallback resolves both the cache directory and revision consistently with the source loader. Suggested small patch at the [helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L87-L126) and [fallback call](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L219-L223), to verify before adopting:

```diff
@@ _copy_cached_hub_files keyword parameters
         revision: str | None,
+        cache_dir: str | Path | None = None,
@@ snapshot_download call
-                        repo_id=repo_id, local_files_only=True, allow_patterns=[file_spec], **revision_kwargs
+                        repo_id=repo_id,
+                        cache_dir=cache_dir,
+                        local_files_only=True,
+                        allow_patterns=[file_spec],
+                        **revision_kwargs,
@@ _copy_custom_modeling_files fallback
-                cached_files = self._copy_cached_hub_files(str(source_path), target_path, patterns, revision=revision)
+                cached_files = self._copy_cached_hub_files(
+                    str(source_path),
+                    target_path,
+                    patterns,
+                    revision=revision,
+                    cache_dir=self.init_kwargs.get("cache_dir"),
+                )
```

**Preservation and acceptance — proposed checks, not run:**
- Add `test_save_artifacts_uses_explicit_hub_cache_when_offline`, using the existing cache-layout helper: cache source revision A only in an explicit cache and a different main revision B in the default cache; construct `MockPreTrainedBase(..., cache_dir=custom_cache)`, force generation-config rejection and offline listing. For both revision A and `revision=None`, require byte-identical source-A output, never B. With the requested file absent from the explicit cache, require the original `ValueError`, even if another cache has it.
- Retain the [default-cache regression's assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L356-L387): pinned/default resolution, nested `sub/helper.py`, regular copied files rather than symlinks, and exclusion of unrelated `config.json`. Retain [per-pattern isolation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L390-L414): copy generation metadata while skipping the incomplete Python pattern.
- Keep local copying and successful Hub listing unchanged. In particular, retain the [online pinned-revision test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L301-L326): both Hub calls use the requested revision and the preserved generation-config bytes match the source.

@@ -84,6 +84,66 @@ def _cleanup_hf_local_dir_cache(target_path: Path) -> None:
         except OSError:
             pass
 
+    @staticmethod
+    def _copy_cached_hub_files(
+        repo_id: str,
+        target_path: Path,
+        patterns: List[str],
+        *,
+        revision: str | None,
+    ) -> List[str]:
+        """Copy files matching patterns from the local Hugging Face cache snapshot of a Hub repository.
+
+        Used when the Hub cannot be listed, for example with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1. Each pattern is
+        resolved separately, so a pattern whose files are not all cached does not block the others.
+        Files are matched and placed by their repository-relative paths, as Hub downloads are.
+
+        Args:
+            repo_id: Hugging Face Hub repository ID.
+            target_path: Directory to copy the files into.
+            patterns: File names or glob patterns, matched against repository-relative paths.
+            revision: Hub revision to read from the cache; None uses the cached default branch.
+
+        Returns:
+            List of copied repository-relative file names; empty if nothing matching is cached.
+        """
+        import fnmatch
+
+        try:
+            from huggingface_hub import snapshot_download
+        except ImportError:
+            return []
+
+        revision_kwargs = {"revision": revision} if revision is not None else {}
+        copied_files = []
+        for file_spec in patterns:
+            try:
+                # allow_patterns limits huggingface_hub's cached-snapshot completeness check to the
+                # requested files, so unrelated files missing from the cache do not fail the lookup.
+                snapshot_dir = Path(
+                    snapshot_download(
+                        repo_id=repo_id, local_files_only=True, allow_patterns=[file_spec], **revision_kwargs
+                    )
+                )
+            except Exception as exc:
+                logger.debug("No cached files of %s match %s: %s", repo_id, file_spec, exc)
+                continue
+
+            cached_files = sorted(path for path in snapshot_dir.rglob("*") if path.is_file())
+            for file_path in cached_files:
+                repo_file = file_path.relative_to(snapshot_dir).as_posix()
+                if repo_file in copied_files or not fnmatch.fnmatch(repo_file, file_spec):
+                    continue
+                target_file = target_path / repo_file
+                try:
+                    target_file.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+                    shutil.copy2(file_path, target_file)
+                    copied_files.append(repo_file)
+                except OSError:
+                    # Silently skip files that can't be copied
+                    pass
+        return copied_files

+_CACHED_REVISION = "dfaf35de3e30f1867dd8dbc38a7fc9fb52d3914f"  # pragma: allowlist secret
+
+
+def _write_hub_cache_snapshot(cache_dir, repo_id, revision, files, listed_missing=()):
+    """Lay out a Hugging Face Hub cache snapshot the way hf_hub_download leaves it.
+
+    Snapshot entries are symlinks to content-addressed blobs. When ``listed_missing`` names
+    repository files absent from the snapshot, a ``trees/<revision>.json`` listing that includes
+    them is written, as huggingface_hub caches after listing the repository online.
+    """
+    repo_dir = cache_dir / f"models--{repo_id.replace('/', '--')}"
+    snapshot_dir = repo_dir / "snapshots" / revision
+    (repo_dir / "blobs").mkdir(parents=True)
+    for name, content in files.items():
+        blob = repo_dir / "blobs" / hashlib.sha1(content.encode()).hexdigest()
+        blob.write_text(content)
+        link = snapshot_dir / name
+        link.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+        link.symlink_to(os.path.relpath(blob, link.parent))
+    (repo_dir / "refs").mkdir()
+    (repo_dir / "refs" / "main").write_text(revision)
+    if listed_missing:
+        listing = {name: {"size": 1, "blob_id": "0" * 40} for name in [*files, *listed_missing]}
+        (repo_dir / "trees").mkdir()
+        (repo_dir / "trees" / f"{revision}.json").write_text(json.dumps({"format_version": 1, "files": listing}))
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("revision", [_CACHED_REVISION, None])
+def test_copy_custom_modeling_files_uses_hub_cache_when_hub_is_offline(tmp_path, monkeypatch, revision):
+    """Test Hub sources fall back to the cached snapshot when the Hub cannot be listed."""
+    import huggingface_hub
+    from huggingface_hub.errors import OfflineModeIsEnabled
+
+    _write_hub_cache_snapshot(
+        tmp_path / "hub",
+        "org/model",
+        _CACHED_REVISION,
+        {
+            "config.json": "{}\n",
+            "generation_config.json": '{"top_p": 0.95}\n',
+            "nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py": "# parser\n",
+            "sub/helper.py": "# helper\n",
+        },
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(huggingface_hub.constants, "HF_HUB_CACHE", str(tmp_path / "hub"))
+    target_dir = tmp_path / "target"
+    target_dir.mkdir()
+
+    base = MockPreTrainedBase()
+    with patch("huggingface_hub.list_repo_files", side_effect=OfflineModeIsEnabled("offline")):
+        copied_files = base._copy_custom_modeling_files(
+            "org/model", target_dir, file_patterns=["generation_config.json", "*.py"], revision=revision
+        )
+
+    assert copied_files == ["generation_config.json", "nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py", "sub/helper.py"]
+    assert (target_dir / "generation_config.json").read_text() == '{"top_p": 0.95}\n'
+    assert (target_dir / "sub" / "helper.py").read_text() == "# helper\n"
+    assert not (target_dir / "generation_config.json").is_symlink()
+    assert not (target_dir / "config.json").exists()
+
+
+def test_copy_custom_modeling_files_uses_incomplete_hub_cache_per_pattern(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Test files missing from the cached snapshot only skip the patterns that need them."""
+    import huggingface_hub
+    from huggingface_hub.errors import OfflineModeIsEnabled
+
+    _write_hub_cache_snapshot(
+        tmp_path / "hub",
+        "org/model",
+        _CACHED_REVISION,
+        {"generation_config.json": '{"top_p": 0.95}\n', "nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py": "# parser\n"},
+        listed_missing=("model.safetensors", "modeling_custom.py"),
+    )
+    monkeypatch.setattr(huggingface_hub.constants, "HF_HUB_CACHE", str(tmp_path / "hub"))
+    target_dir = tmp_path / "target"
+    target_dir.mkdir()
+
+    base = MockPreTrainedBase()
+    with patch("huggingface_hub.list_repo_files", side_effect=OfflineModeIsEnabled("offline")):
+        copied_files = base._copy_custom_modeling_files(
+            "org/model", target_dir, file_patterns=["generation_config.json", "*.py"], revision=_CACHED_REVISION
+        )
+
+    assert copied_files == ["generation_config.json"]
+    assert (target_dir / "generation_config.json").read_text() == '{"top_p": 0.95}\n'
+    assert not (target_dir / "nano_v3_reasoning_parser.py").exists()
+
+
+def test_save_artifacts_preserves_generation_config_from_hub_cache_when_offline(tmp_path, monkeypatch):
+    """Test the rejected-generation-config fallback for a cached Hub model with HF_HUB_OFFLINE=1."""
+    import huggingface_hub
+    from huggingface_hub.errors import OfflineModeIsEnabled
+
+    generation_config = '{"temperature": 1.0, "top_p": 0.95}\n'
+    _write_hub_cache_snapshot(
+        tmp_path / "hub",

[P2] Honor the source loader's explicit cache directory

**Failure — source reasoning, not executed:** `PreTrainedCausalLM.from_pretrained("org/model", cache_dir=custom_cache)` loads generation metadata from that cache because the [loader forwards `self.init_kwargs`](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/causal_lm.py#L249-L257). This snapshot lookup instead always uses the default cache. Offline, if `custom_cache` contains the loaded main revision with `{"top_p": 0.95}` while the default cache contains an older main with `{"top_p": 0.8}`, a rejected generation-config save copies the older file and incorrectly succeeds. With an explicit commit cached only in `custom_cache`, the helper returns no files and [the save re-raises](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L298-L305) despite the source file being available. Expected behavior is to preserve the artifact from the cache used to load the source.

**Correction:** thread `self.init_kwargs.get("cache_dir")` through `_copy_custom_modeling_files` into `_copy_cached_hub_files` and `snapshot_download`. The invariant is that the fallback resolves both the cache directory and revision consistently with the source loader. Suggested small patch at the [helper](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L87-L126) and [fallback call](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/src/megatron/bridge/models/hf_pretrained/base.py#L219-L223), to verify before adopting:

```diff
@@ _copy_cached_hub_files keyword parameters
         revision: str | None,
+        cache_dir: str | Path | None = None,
@@ snapshot_download call
-                        repo_id=repo_id, local_files_only=True, allow_patterns=[file_spec], **revision_kwargs
+                        repo_id=repo_id,
+                        cache_dir=cache_dir,
+                        local_files_only=True,
+                        allow_patterns=[file_spec],
+                        **revision_kwargs,
@@ _copy_custom_modeling_files fallback
-                cached_files = self._copy_cached_hub_files(str(source_path), target_path, patterns, revision=revision)
+                cached_files = self._copy_cached_hub_files(
+                    str(source_path),
+                    target_path,
+                    patterns,
+                    revision=revision,
+                    cache_dir=self.init_kwargs.get("cache_dir"),
+                )
```

**Preservation and acceptance — proposed checks, not run:**
- Add `test_save_artifacts_uses_explicit_hub_cache_when_offline`, using the existing cache-layout helper: cache source revision A only in an explicit cache and a different main revision B in the default cache; construct `MockPreTrainedBase(..., cache_dir=custom_cache)`, force generation-config rejection and offline listing. For both revision A and `revision=None`, require byte-identical source-A output, never B. With the requested file absent from the explicit cache, require the original `ValueError`, even if another cache has it.
- Retain the [default-cache regression's assertions](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L356-L387): pinned/default resolution, nested `sub/helper.py`, regular copied files rather than symlinks, and exclusion of unrelated `config.json`. Retain [per-pattern isolation](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L390-L414): copy generation metadata while skipping the incomplete Python pattern.
- Keep local copying and successful Hub listing unchanged. In particular, retain the [online pinned-revision test](https://github.com/NVIDIA-NeMo/Megatron-Bridge/blob/905e9ce350029799e2dd67b1f453004c85e16027/tests/unit_tests/models/hf_pretrained/test_base.py#L301-L326): both Hub calls use the requested revision and the preserved generation-config bytes match the source.
